# QEhome Manresa

QEhome is a holiday apartment in central Manresa, Catalonia. It offers two bedrooms, an equipped kitchen, WiFi, self check-in, a private parking space in the same building and an electric car charger. Guests pay separately for the electricity used to charge a vehicle.

Official website: https://qehomemanresa.com/
Address: Carrer Doctor Esteve 9, Manresa, Barcelona, Spain
Telephone: +34 640 95 55 72
Email: qehomemanresa@gmail.com
